voicemoat.description: VoiceMoat, the personal brand OS for LinkedIn and Twitter. Check drafts for Style and Stance against your own voice profile, improve them, get hook and post ideas, read your post analytics, and publish or schedule posts. Posting is two-step: the first call returns a preview and a one-time code, and only a second call with that code posts. Hosted remote server (Streamable HTTP). Requires a VoiceMoat account on Pro or Enterprise, or the $5 Pro trial (https://voicemoat.com/mcp). Uses OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration, PKCE): the MCP client prompts you to sign in on first use. Setup: https://docs.voicemoat.com/connect-voicemoat-to-an-assistant
